description.zh: 静态网站托管测试域名允许访问IP的白名单，不在白名单中的访问可能会被限制，仅支持配置ipv4，可以配置IP或者IP网段，掩码位数取值范围24-31，最多可同时配置三个，多个之间用逗号隔开。
description.en: The whitelist of IP addresses allowed to access the test domain name for static website hosting. Access from IPs not on the whitelist may be restricted. Only IPv4 addresses are supported. You can configure either individual IP addresses or IP segments. The mask length must be between 24 and 31, inclusive. Up to three entries can be configured simultaneously, separated by commas.

description.zh: 当配置了ErrorPath之后，该页面对应的HTTP状态码，可选值404和200，默认为404。
description.en: The HTTP status code corresponding to the error page after ErrorPath is configured. Valid values are 404 and 200. The default value is 404.
